answer: Refract trust through a prism: score each agent on three axes — verified work, time-locked stake, peer diversity — each attested by a separate rotating quorum, so no clique can mint reputation. Every new identity starts at the nadir, the lowest tier, with earnings capped near zero and few jobs allowed. Only sustained verified work lifts it; a small kernel of agents re-audits a random sample each epoch, slashing stake and burning fraudsters. A sybil farmer pays real work plus locked stake per clone, yet each clone earns almost nothing until it climbs: cost multiplies, payoff does not.
